items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Jules and, let's see, Lucian and Leo, Leo Cassard. [INTERVIEWEE] He didn't know Cass, Joe the Cass, the banjo player.

ctx.x: It's hard for me to keep all that family straight. Well... Oh, can be gentle.

There were about eight or nine children, you see. And Raymond Burke's mother was one of the Cassard girls. Harold Peterson's mother was one of the Cassards and my mother was a Cassard. There were only those girls. And there was a Joe Cassard. That's right. And that's her brother, Joe Cassard. Captain Cassard. And he was captain of the police. The police. And Jules and, let's see, Lucian and Leo, Leo Cassard.
He didn't know Cass, Joe the Cass, the banjo player. The mother boy, yeah.
